events.title: England suffer their first defeat of this World Cup qualifying series, losing 2–0 to Norway in Oslo .

Former assistant manager Alan Smith is promoted to role of manager at 크리스털 팰리스. 반즐리 recruit 36-year-old defender 비브 앤더슨 from 셰필드 웬즈데이 to become their new player-manager. Neil Warnock ends his tenure at 토키 유나이티드, and is replaced by player-assistant manager Don O'Riordan .
글렌 호들 is named as 첼시's new manager. Hoddle, 36, will also be registered as a player with the club.
폴 인스 becomes England's first black captain in their 2–0 defeat against the United States in Foxborough, Massachusetts .
David Kelly , whose 25 Division One goals helped 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 reach the Premier League this season, completes a £750,000 transfer to 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
아스널 pay 크리스털 팰리스 £1 million for Ireland winger Eddie McGoldrick .
맨체스터 유나이티드 break the national transfer record by paying 노팅엄 포리스트 £3.75 million for Roy Keane .
데이비드 오리어리 , who has spent his whole career playing for 아스널, moves to 리즈 유나이티드 on a free transfer.

Ossie Ardiles , who won promotion from Division Two as manager of 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 this year, is unveiled as manager of 토트넘 홋스퍼. His assistant at 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, former Spurs boss Keith Burkinshaw , succeeds him.

Peter Beardsley signs for 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in a £1.5 million deal from 에버턴, six years after he left Tyneside . 노팅엄 포리스트 prepare for their promotion push by paying £2.5 million for 사우스엔드 유나이티드 striker Stan Collymore .
Merthyr Tydfil decide against joining the League of Wales and opt to remain in the GM Vauxhall Conference .

Edwin Stein resigns as 바닛 manager and follows his predecessor Barry Fry to 사우스엔드 유나이티드, where he becomes assistant manager. Goalkeeper and club captain Gary Phillips is provisionally announced as manager for the following season, though it remains to be seen whether 바닛 will even start the next season due to their financial problems.
